description: This file declares the TrustStoreMac class, an implementation of TrustStore that uses macOS keychain to find trust anchors for certificate path building. It includes enums for trust debug info and implementation types, a nested class for debug data, and methods for trust evaluation and issuer retrieval.

classes.name: TrustStoreMac
classes.description: A thread-safe implementation of TrustStore that utilizes macOS keychain for trust anchor retrieval, with debug info and trust implementation type enums, and methods for trust and issuer management.

classes.name: TrustStoreMac::ResultDebugData
classes.description: A class for storing and managing debug data related to trust evaluation, including trust debug info flags and trust implementation type.

methods.name: TrustStoreMac
methods.description: Constructor that initializes TrustStoreMac with a policy OID and implementation type.

methods.name: InitializeTrustCache
methods.description: Initializes the trust cache if not already initialized.

methods.name: SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates matching a given certificate.

methods.name: GetTrust
methods.description: Evaluates and returns trust information for a given certificate, with debug data.
